Several papers explore AI-generated feedback or iterative self-improvement for complex reasoning and rules. Test-time Recursive Thinking generates verification signals to improve answers without external feedback [1], while Native Reasoning Training uses self-generated reasoning traces and an intrinsic reward loop to improve complex reasoning without expert-written demonstrations [5].

For agents and explicit rules, RoboPhD evolves Text-to-SQL strategies from performance feedback without external domain guidance [6], and RuleEvolve iteratively mutates and evaluates coding rules [10]. CoNL uses self-play critiques that are rewarded when they help improve solutions, without external judges or ground-truth labels [8].
